newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH 4-WK T-BILL GROSS YIELD 25 PCT, DEMAND HEAVY.
newsitem.headline: CZECH 4-WK T-BILL GROSS YIELD 25 PCT, DEMAND HEAVY.

text.p: Gross yield in a Czech National Bank auction on Thursday offering five billion crowns in four-week treasury bills to the market was 25 percent and the auction was oversubscribed, the CNB said.
It said that the total volume of 20 billion crowns included 15 billion crowns in bills bought by the finance ministry for its own portfolio, and bids from the market totalled 6.264 billion crowns.
